violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cheeseburger patty (122F) and commerically prepared fried spicy chicken patty both inside the Delfield 1 Dr UR warmer cabinet in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: CFM reheated the cheeseburger patties and commercially prepared fried spicy chicken in the oven to 165F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: containers salad mix x 2 (44F and 45F) on cold plates in both students serving lines. EHS observed the salad mix container on top of another tray (barrier in between the salad container and the cold plate).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated both containers of salad mix to the walk in refrigerator to cool to 41 or below and replace with salad mix on both students serving lines with bags of salad mix stored inside the walk in refrigerator.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: torn door gasket on the right door of the Delfield 2 UR refrigerator in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EHS instructed CFM to repair right door gasket of the Delfield 2 Dr UR refrigerator in the main kicthen.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: salad mix (49F and 48F) cold holding on cold plate at salad bar in the student self serving lunch line side # 1 and 2. Multiple barriers between the cold plate and salad container.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated both of the containers to the Kolpak walk in refrigerator to cool back down to 41F. CFM stated she will talk to management about remove some of the barriers in between the salad container and cold plate. CFM stated she will reduce the amount of salad mix in the container to better facilitate proper cold holding of 41F or below.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Two employees were observed making and drinking a smoothie on a prep table in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. Smoothies removed from kitchen, educated staff.
